macros.name: implicantedge

arg.snippet: implicantedge{${1:northwest part northwest cell}}{${2:northwest part southeast cell}}{${3:southeast part northwest cell}}{${4:southeast part southeast cell}}[${5:submaps}]

macros.doc: The \implicantedge command draws quadratic implicants with the middle of the implicant facing the edge of a submap either horizontally or vertically.

macros.name: indeterminants
macros.doc: The \indeterminants command fills the specified cells with ”-” if they aren’t already filled.

macros.name: manualterms
macros.doc: The \manualterms command fills the 0th cell with the first element in the argument, the 1st cell with the second element in the argument, and so on.

macros.name: maxterms
macros.doc: The \maxterms command fills the specified cells with ”0” if they aren’t already filled.

macros.name: minterms
macros.doc: The \minterms command fills the specified cells with ”1” if they aren’t already filled.

macros.name: terms
macros.doc: The \terms command fills the specified cells with the specified content if they aren’t already filled.
